title: 交通事故
description: 交通事故現場的溝通用語

sentences.en: There's been a car accident.
Are you okay?
Is anyone injured?
We need to call for help.
Can I see your insurance information?
sentences.zh: 我可以看你的保險資料嗎？

sentences.en: The damage is on the rear bumper.
I have a dashcam recording.
Were there any witnesses?
He ran a red light.
The other driver was speeding.
Let's move the cars to the side of the road.
I need to exchange contact information.
sentences.zh: 我們需要交換聯絡資訊。

sentences.en: My car won't start after the collision.
sentences.zh: 碰撞後我的車發不動了。

sentences.en: I need a tow truck.
The airbag deployed.
I think I have whiplash.
Please don't leave the scene.
I'd like to take photos of the damage.
sentences.zh: 我想拍一下損傷的照片。

sentences.en: The road is blocked.
A motorcycle hit my car.
I was rear-ended at the intersection.
Should we file an accident report?
sentences.zh: 我們需要填事故報告嗎？

sentences.en: I'll contact my insurance company.
sentences.zh: 我會聯絡我的保險公司。

sentences.en: The traffic light was green on my side.
A pedestrian was hit by a car.
The bicycle was in my blind spot.
sentences.zh: 那台腳踏車在我的視線死角。

sentences.en: I'm not sure whose fault it was.
We should wait for the police to arrive.
Can you describe what happened?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下發生了什麼嗎？

sentences.en: I need to report this to my insurance.
sentences.zh: 我需要向保險公司通報這件事。
